name: Scratchpad Frame
author: AktOn1
description: A frame around the scratchpad (SUPER + S) that slides in and out with it. Forty-eight styles, from clean vector lines to photographed wood, slate and moss and game-UI frames; each scratchpad can have its own style, entrance and exit. Describe a frame in a few words and your own AI picks and colours a style, with an optional corner ornament from your own image model. Recolour styles from your Omarchy theme. Bar icon and keyboard style menu with live preview.

barWidget.description: Scratchpads overview; click one to pick its frame style from groups with a live thumbnail, theme colours, title
